title: Miller E5 human acceptance record
description: Immutable, content-addressed record of a human visual/audio/narrative review, per QAE-001 (EVALUATION_PLAN.md). Write-once: a record is never edited after content_hash is computed; a later review supersedes it via the supersedes field instead.

record_id.description: e5_ prefix followed by the sha256 of the record's canonical content (content_hash).

supersedes.description: record_id of an earlier record this one replaces (e.g. after a repair pass), or null for a first review.

roadmap_item.description: The sprint/roadmap item this acceptance record supports, e.g. STO-005, REL-002.

source_hashes.description: Optional map of source-input name to sha256, for provenance.

identifier.description: Name, handle, or other stable identifier for the reviewer. Never store secrets/credentials here.

reviewers.description: Exactly one primary_reviewer is required (EVALUATION_PLAN.md); secondary_reviewer is optional.

scores.description: Dimension name to 1-5 integer score, per the rubric in EVALUATION_PLAN.md (visual/audio/narrative dimensions).

overall_score.description: Unweighted mean of the scores map.

threshold_result.description: Derived from overall_score and the per-dimension floor rule in EVALUATION_PLAN.md; never set by automated review alone.

resolution.description: Consensus note, or an explicit statement that no consensus was reached and the primary reviewer's score is authoritative.

automated_flags.description: Advisory findings from src/miller/quality/ (editorial.py, media.py). Informational only; never sets threshold_result.

content_hash.description: sha256 of this record's canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) with the derived content_hash and record_id fields excluded from the hashed payload.
